description: This file defines the Subunit class, a part of the report filtering system within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a FilterField to handle filtering by organizational subunits, providing methods to modify database queries, retrieve subunit data, and convert subunit IDs into a human-readable array format.

classes.name: Subunit
classes.description: A class for handling organizational subunit filtering in report queries, supporting conversion of subunit IDs to labels, query modification, and retrieving subunit info.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a conditional 'IN' clause to the query builder based on selected subunits, enhancing report filtering capabilities.

methods.name: getSubunitIds
methods.description: Returns an array of subunit IDs parsed from the 'x' parameter, supporting nested subunit selections.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Specifies the aliases used for entities in queries, here indicating 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the first subunit ID into an associative array with 'id' and 'label' for display purposes.

methods.name: xValueModifier
methods.description: Converts a comma-separated list of subunit IDs into a chain of subunit names for display or further processing.
